WheelbaseAPITokenCredential.title: Wheelbase API Token
WheelbaseAPITokenCredential.x-credential-instructions: Paste an existing Wheelbase Partner API bearer token. Use a production token for api.wheelbasepro.com, without the Bearer prefix. The token needs the read/write scopes for your selected operations; dealer-only operations also need a dealer-scoped token. NoClick does not mint or refresh tokens. Replace an expired or revoked token here. Connection checks read only the current credential at /v1/me.

WheelbaseApproveBooking.description:
Approve a booking. Approves the booking from the calling credential's side (renter if user_id = renter_id, owner otherwise). Both sides approving triggers payment capture / confirmation.

**Sending a quote:** when a dealer creates a booking on behalf of a customer and then calls approve, the platform marks the owner side approved and emails the customer their quote with a link to review and pay. Include `reason` to add a personal message to that email and the conversation thread.

reason.description: Optional free-text note. On approve it's delivered to the customer as a message (and included in the quote email).
reason.title: Reason

notify.description: Set false to suppress the platform email for this transition — e.g. when you send the customer a checkout link through your own channel (see POST /v1/bookings/{id}/links).
notify.title: Notify

WheelbaseApproveBooking.title: WheelbaseApproveBooking

WheelbaseCancelBooking.description: Cancel a booking. Cancels a confirmed booking. Returns 409 if the booking has not been confirmed (use /decline instead). Cancellation may trigger refund logic per the listing's cancel policy.

reason.description: Optional free-text note. On approve it's delivered to the customer as a message (and included in the quote email).
reason.title: Reason

notify.description: Set false to suppress the platform email for this transition — e.g. when you send the customer a checkout link through your own channel (see POST /v1/bookings/{id}/links).
notify.title: Notify

WheelbaseCancelBooking.title: WheelbaseCancelBooking

WheelbaseCreateBooking.description:
Create a booking. Creates a booking in `negotiating` status.

Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to make retries safe — repeating a request with the same key returns the original response instead of creating a duplicate booking. Without the header, every request creates a new booking.

Payment collection (Stripe client_secret) is not yet wired here; a dedicated endpoint will be added for that.

idempotency_key.description: Optional but strongly recommended in production. Any unique string per logical create; retrying with the same key returns the original response instead of creating a duplicate booking.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

insurance_option_id.description: Insurance/protection option to apply (id from GET /v1/listings/{id}/insurance-options). Omit to use the listing default.
insurance_option_id.title: Insurance Option Id

delivery.description: Deliver to an address instead of lot pickup. The platform geocodes it and prices the delivery fee (tiered mileage vs minimum), returned as a `delivery` line item. Omit for lot pickup.

addons.description: Optional add-ons (ids from GET /v1/listings/{id}/addons). Required items (prep fees etc.) are attached automatically — do not send them.
addons.title: Addons

WheelbaseCreateBooking.title: WheelbaseCreateBooking

WheelbaseCreateBookingLink.description:
Create a shareable checkout link. Mints a single-use-style deep link the customer can open without a password — resolving it signs them in and lands them on the booking's checkout or payment step. Send it through your own channel (SMS, email).

Only available when the booking's customer is one of **your** customers (`managed_by: "dealer"`) — marketplace customers have their own accounts and cannot be signed in via links. Links expire after ~3 days; mint a fresh one per send.

Typical flow for a dealer-sent quote: create the booking → `POST /{id}/approve` with `notify: false` → create a `payment` link → send it to the customer yourself.

type.description: `booking` — lands the customer in the checkout flow for the booking. `payment` — jumps straight to the payment step (or the make-a-payment section on a confirmed booking).
type.title: Type

WheelbaseCreateBookingLink.title: WheelbaseCreateBookingLink

WheelbaseCreateCustomer.description:
Create a customer. Creates a dealer-managed customer. Find-or-create semantics by email: if a customer with this email already exists in your account, that record is updated and returned instead of creating a duplicate.

Created customers are `managed_by: "dealer"` and fully editable. You cannot create a customer using your own account email.

location_ids.description: Dealer locations to associate the customer with.
location_ids.title: Location Ids

WheelbaseCreateCustomer.title: WheelbaseCreateCustomer

WheelbaseCreateQuote.description: Get a quote. Returns a non-destructive full price breakdown for a listing and date range. Quote calculation does not reserve availability or create a booking.

addons.description: Optional add-ons to include (ids from GET /v1/listings/{id}/addons). Each shows up in line_items with its cost and tax.
addons.title: Addons

insurance_option_id.description: Insurance/protection option to price into the quote (id from GET /v1/listings/{id}/insurance-options). Omit to use the listing default.
insurance_option_id.title: Insurance Option Id

delivery.description: Deliver to an address instead of lot pickup. The platform geocodes it and prices the delivery fee (tiered mileage vs minimum), returned as a `delivery` line item. Omit for lot pickup.

WheelbaseCreateQuote.title: WheelbaseCreateQuote

WheelbaseDeclineBooking.description: Decline a booking. Declines a pre-confirmation booking. Returns 409 if the booking is already confirmed (use /cancel instead).

reason.description: Optional free-text note. On approve it's delivered to the customer as a message (and included in the quote email).
reason.title: Reason

notify.description: Set false to suppress the platform email for this transition — e.g. when you send the customer a checkout link through your own channel (see POST /v1/bookings/{id}/links).
notify.title: Notify

WheelbaseDeclineBooking.title: WheelbaseDeclineBooking

lat.description: Optional; skips geocoding when both lat/lng are set.
lat.title: Lat

stationary.description: True when the vehicle stays parked at the delivery address (no return trip).
stationary.title: Stationary

comment.description: Note for the dealer about the delivery.
comment.title: Comment

WheelbaseGetAccount.description: Get current credential. Returns the identity and metadata for the credential authenticating this request. Useful for verifying an integration is wired up correctly ("is my token being accepted, and as whom?"). No scope required.
WheelbaseGetAccount.title: WheelbaseGetAccount

WheelbaseGetBooking.description: Get a booking. Returns a single booking. Only accessible to the renter or the owner of the associated listing.
WheelbaseGetBooking.title: WheelbaseGetBooking

WheelbaseGetBookingMessages.description: Get a booking's message thread. Returns the full renter conversation attached to a booking, oldest message first. Authors are normalized to renter/dealer/system. Reading does NOT mark the thread read in the Wheelbase dashboard.
WheelbaseGetBookingMessages.title: WheelbaseGetBookingMessages

WheelbaseGetCustomer.description:
Get a customer. Returns a single customer.

Dealer-managed customers (`managed_by: "dealer"`) return all fields. Marketplace customers are only readable when they have an interaction with your account (booking or conversation) — otherwise 404 — and their `email`/`phone` are populated only once a confirmed booking exists. `birthdate` is never available for marketplace customers.
WheelbaseGetCustomer.title: WheelbaseGetCustomer

WheelbaseGetListing.description:
Get listing detail. Returns source-of-truth detail for a single listing. Use this for read-modify-write flows — the search index is eventually consistent.

Dealer credentials (with `owner_ids`) can only view listings in their own fleet; other listings return 404 (same as if the listing didn't exist, to avoid confirming other dealers' listing IDs). Marketplace credentials (empty `owner_ids`) can view any listing.
WheelbaseGetListing.title: WheelbaseGetListing

WheelbaseGetListingAvailability.description:
Get a listing's availability. Returns the date ranges that cannot be booked within the window — existing bookings, owner blocks, and turnaround buffer days, merged into anonymous ranges. Dates not listed are available.

This reads the booking source of truth (not the search index) and reflects the same rules booking creation enforces.

to_date.description: Window end (inclusive). Defaults to 12 months from `from`. Max window: 24 months.
to_date.title: To Date

WheelbaseGetListingAvailability.title: WheelbaseGetListingAvailability

WheelbaseListBookingDocuments.description: List a booking's documents. Returns the booking's documents: platform-generated PDFs (receipt, contract, e-sign receipt, departure/return forms) and uploaded files (driver documents, message attachments). Fetch on demand — availability of generated documents changes with booking state (e.g. the receipt appears once the booking is approved).
WheelbaseListBookingDocuments.title: WheelbaseListBookingDocuments

WheelbaseListBookingPayments.description:
List a booking's payments. Returns the booking's money movement, newest first, in two groups:

- `payments` — the customer timeline: settled charges and refunds plus scheduled/pending future charges (e.g. the remainder auto-charge). `scheduled: true` entries carry a `due_date`; refund entries carry `original_payment_id`.
- `payouts` — money paid out to your account for this booking, with expected/actual bank deposit dates.

Complements the `payment` block on booking detail: that block is the summary (total paid / balance / plan); this is the itemized history behind it.
WheelbaseListBookingPayments.title: WheelbaseListBookingPayments

WheelbaseListBookings.description: List bookings. Returns bookings the credential participates in — either as renter (bookings where renter_id = credential user_id) or as owner (bookings on rentals in the credential's owner_ids).

customer_id.description: Only this customer's bookings (find the id via GET /v1/customers). Dealer credentials only.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

start_date_from.description: Only return bookings whose start_date is on/after this date.
start_date_from.title: Start Date From

WheelbaseListBookings.title: WheelbaseListBookings

WheelbaseListCustomers.description:
Search customers. Searches the dealer's customers — both dealer-managed records and marketplace guests who have booked with the dealer.

Marketplace customers (`managed_by: "marketplace"`) have `email` and `phone` masked (empty strings) in search results, regardless of booking history. Use `GET /v1/customers/{id}` to read contact info once a confirmed booking exists.

search.description: Matches name, email, phone, or customer id.
search.title: Search

repeat_guest.description: Only customers with more than one booking.
repeat_guest.title: Repeat Guest

active_guest.description: Only customers with a current or upcoming booking.
active_guest.title: Active Guest

WheelbaseListCustomers.title: WheelbaseListCustomers

WheelbaseListInsuranceOptions.description: List a listing’s insurance options. The insurance/protection options (tiers) offered on a listing — price per day, deductible, coverage summary, and feature list. Dealer credentials get dealer-priced options; other credentials get marketplace pricing.
WheelbaseListInsuranceOptions.title: WheelbaseListInsuranceOptions

WheelbaseListListingAddons.description:
List a listing's add-ons. Returns the optional add-ons bookable on this listing (account-wide and listing-specific, filtered to what applies at its location and vehicle type). Apply them via `addons: [{id, quantity}]` on POST /v1/quotes or booking create/update.

Required items (prep fees etc.) are attached to bookings automatically and are not listed here.
WheelbaseListListingAddons.title: WheelbaseListListingAddons

WheelbaseListListings.description: Search listings. Returns a page of listings matching the supplied filters. Backed by an eventually-consistent search index; use GET /v1/listings/{id} for source-of-truth state.

location.description: Free-text location search (city, address, or place name).
location.title: Location

WheelbaseListListings.title: WheelbaseListListings

WheelbaseListLocations.description: List locations. Returns the dealer's pickup/drop-off locations with address and weekly hours. Use the ids with the `location_ids` filters on vehicle/booking reports and customer search — and to tie a booking or vehicle to its pickup location's hours.
WheelbaseListLocations.title: WheelbaseListLocations

WheelbaseListMessageThreads.description: List message threads. Returns the credential's renter message threads, newest activity first. Each row carries the follow-up signals — last_message_at, last_message_author, unread — so a queue can skip renters who already replied. Reading threads does NOT mark them read in the Wheelbase dashboard.

unread_only.description: Only threads with unread renter activity.
unread_only.title: Unread Only

WheelbaseListMessageThreads.title: WheelbaseListMessageThreads

WheelbaseUpdateBooking.description: Modify a booking. Partially update a booking. Only dates, guests, discount code, and insurance can be modified. Go api rejects updates once a booking is confirmed — you'll see a 400 with an upstream reason.

insurance_option_id.description: Change the insurance/protection option (id from GET /v1/listings/{id}/insurance-options).
insurance_option_id.title: Insurance Option Id

delivery.description: Deliver to an address instead of lot pickup. The platform geocodes it and prices the delivery fee (tiered mileage vs minimum), returned as a `delivery` line item. Omit for lot pickup.

addons.description: The full optional add-on set for the booking (a replace, not a delta). Send the complete desired list (ids from GET /v1/listings/{id}/addons) — any add-on you leave out is removed, and `[]` removes all. Omit this field entirely to leave add-ons unchanged. Required items (prep fees, etc.) are managed automatically — do not send them.
addons.title: Addons

WheelbaseUpdateBooking.title: WheelbaseUpdateBooking

WheelbaseUpdateCustomer.description: Update a customer. Partially update a dealer-managed customer. Marketplace customers (`managed_by: "marketplace"`) are managed by the marketplace and cannot be edited — attempts return 403.
WheelbaseUpdateCustomer.title: WheelbaseUpdateCustomer

WheelbaseUpdateListing.description: Update a listing. Partially update a listing. Only whitelisted fields (`name`, `description`, `price_per_day`, `instant_book`) are accepted; anything else is silently dropped. The authenticated user must have owner-equivalent rights on the listing.

price_per_day.description: Nightly rate in minor units (cents) — matches `price_per_day.value` from GET responses.
price_per_day.title: Price Per Day

WheelbaseUpdateListing.title: WheelbaseUpdateListing
